rules: All tests are dry-run, functional, or low-volume. Never run DDoS, brute-force, destructive, credential-stuffing, or uncontrolled scanning traffic.

cases.expected: 2xx/3xx HTTPS navigation
representative same-origin assets return 2xx/3xx with correct content types
cache status is reported; no hit is assumed before provider cutover
normal status and reviewed CORS headers
valid login works; failed-login controls do not lock out ordinary users
legitimate submission succeeds and abusive repetition is constrained

cases.prerequisite: test signed webhook sender and staging endpoint
cases.expected: valid signature succeeds without browser challenge; invalid signature is rejected by application
provider-verified crawler bypasses generic bot challenge while managed exploit inspection remains
explicit approved monitoring identity/CIDR remains functional
observe/challenge/block according to rollout state
managed WAF event/action recorded
managed WAF event/action recorded
custom/managed WAF event/action recorded
ordinary repetition does not trigger unsafe traffic generation
moderate oversized metadata probe is observed; provider limit testing stays below destructive levels

cases.prerequisite: geo enforcement explicitly enabled on staging
cases.expected: configured country action occurs
configured ASN action occurs
narrow exception works without skipping unrelated managed WAF protections
managed challenge renders/solves correctly and solve/failure metrics are recorded
HSTS/CSP-Report-Only/nosniff/referrer/permissions/frame controls are present
final navigation is HTTPS
GitHub Pages may remain directly reachable; private future origin should not
untrusted forwarding header does not poison subsequent clean cached response
specific rule moves to observe/narrow exception; entire WAF is not disabled
